functions.name: USB_ADDR0_RX
remarks: USB 包缓冲区（PMA）表项：地址 = USB_PMAADDR + 由 USB_BTABLE 寄存器给出的表内偏移，不是固定成员访问
functions.exampleCode:
uint32_t btable = USB->BTABLE;  /* 包缓冲表基址（相对 PMA 起始） */
uint16_t pma_off = (uint16_t)(btable + 0x0000u);  /* USB_ADDR0_RX 的表内偏移 */
uint32_t v = *(volatile uint32_t *)(USB_PMAADDR + pma_off);  /* 读 */
*(volatile uint32_t *)(USB_PMAADDR + pma_off) = v;  /* 写回 */

functions.name: USB_BTABLE
functions.briefEn: Buffer Table address register, Address offset: 0x50
remarks: 结构体成员 USB_TypeDef.BTABLE，偏移 0x50
functions.exampleCode:
uint32_t v = USB->BTABLE;  /* 读回当前值 */
v &= ~USB_BTABLE_BTABLE_Msk;  /* 先清掉 USB_BTABLE_BTABLE：bits[15:3]（整个位域） */
v |= (1u << USB_BTABLE_BTABLE_Pos) & USB_BTABLE_BTABLE_Msk;  /* 置位，实际取值看参考手册 */
USB->BTABLE = v;  /* 写回 */

functions.name: USB_CNTR

params.name: USB_CNTR_ESOFM
params.descEn: Expected Start Of Frame Interrupt Mask

params.name: USB_CNTR_PMAOVRM
params.descEn: Packet Memory Area Over / Underrun Interrupt Mask

remarks: 结构体成员 USB_TypeDef.CNTR，偏移 0x40
functions.exampleCode:
uint32_t v = USB->CNTR;  /* 读回当前值 */
v &= ~USB_CNTR_FRES_Msk;  /* 先清掉 USB_CNTR_FRES：bit 0（整个位域） */
v |= (1u << USB_CNTR_FRES_Pos) & USB_CNTR_FRES_Msk;  /* 置位，实际取值看参考手册 */
USB->CNTR = v;  /* 写回 */
